panel.until_off: On until you turn it off
panel.off: Off: idle screen-off, lock and suspend apply
panel.lid_hint: Also stop lid close from suspending

notify.lid_failed: Couldn't start the lid inhibitor; see `systemctl --user status caffeinate-plus-lid`.

presets_minutes.label: Presets (minutes)
presets_minutes.description: Durations offered in the panel, in minutes

scroll_step_minutes.label: Scroll step (minutes)
scroll_step_minutes.description: Time added or removed per scroll step over the bar widget

cancel_on_lock.label: Turn off when the screen locks
cancel_on_lock.description: Locking ends the session. Caffeine turns off if a timer was running or this plugin turned it on

lid_inhibit.label: Ignore lid close by default
lid_inhibit.description: While caffeine is on, also stop lid close from suspending

dim_on_lid_close.label: Turn display off on lid close
dim_on_lid_close.description: Requires Ignore lid close. While a session runs, set the internal display brightness to 0 when the lid closes and restore it when it opens

show_remaining.label: Show remaining time
show_remaining.description: Show the countdown next to the icon while a timer runs
